
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/mengrennwpu/p/19222764" title="发布于 2025-11-14 17:18">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">LLM应用剖析: 舆情分析多智能体-微舆BettaFish</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/602535/202511/602535-20251114171743813-1962254837.png" alt="LLM应用剖析: 舆情分析多智能体-微舆BettaFish" class="desc_img">
        本文主要讲解了微舆的整体架构，并通过研读并调试源码，整理了多个Agent各自的执行流程。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>1.&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-family: 黑体">背景</span> </strong></h2>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">近两周</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">github</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">一直霸榜的国产项目</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">-</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">微舆，引起了广泛的关注，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">11</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">月</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">3</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">日</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">start</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">数</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">3.4K</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，截止今天</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">11</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">月</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">14</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">日，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">start</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">数</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">26.6K</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，火箭原地起飞。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">前几个月我也从事了舆情分析的相关项目，遂抱着学习的态度，花费了</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">3</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">天时间研究并调试了其中的运行机制。</span></p>
<h2>2.&nbsp;<strong>特色功能</strong></h2>
<p>(1)&nbsp;AI<span style="font-family: 宋体">驱动的全网舆情监控系统</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">基于全天候运行的</span>AI<span style="font-family: 宋体">爬虫集群，覆盖微博、小红书、抖音、快手等</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">10</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">余个国内外主流社交平台。该系统不仅能实时追踪热点话题，还可深入挖掘海量用户评论，捕捉真实、多元的公众声音</span>。</p>
<p>(2)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">超越单一模型的复合分析系统</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">融合了</span>5<span style="font-family: 宋体">类自研专业</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、微调模型与统计中间件，形成多模型协同的分析架构。通过多模型互补增强，分析结果在深度、准确性与多维度视角上得到有效保证</span>。</p>
<p>(3)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">多模态信息解析能力</span></p>
<p align="justify"><span style="font-family: 宋体">突破图文限制，支持对抖音、快手等平台短视频内容的深度理解，并能精准提取天气、股票、日历等搜索引擎中的结构化多模态信息卡片，为全面把握舆情动态提供支持</span>。</p>
<p align="justify">(4)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">基于</span>Agent“<span style="font-family: 宋体">圆桌讨论</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">”</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的协作机制</span></p>
<p align="justify"><span style="font-family: 宋体">为不同</span>Agent<span style="font-family: 宋体">赋予专属工具与思维模式，并引入</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">“</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">主持人</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">”</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">模型，通过链式辩论与思维碰撞，打破模型同质化局限，有助于激发更高质量的集体智慧与决策建议</span>。</p>
<p align="justify">(5)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">公私域数据无缝整合</span></p>
<p align="justify"><span style="font-family: 宋体">除洞察公开舆情外，还提供高安全性接口，实现内部业务数据与舆情信息的高效融合。此举有助于打破数据孤岛，构建</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">“</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">外部趋势</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">+</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">内部实情</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">”</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">一体化的垂直业务洞察体系</span>。</p>
<p align="justify">(6)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">轻量灵活的扩展架构</span></p>
<p align="justify"><span style="font-family: 宋体">采用纯</span>Python<span style="font-family: 宋体">模块化设计，系统具备轻量化部署与灵活扩展的特性。清晰的代码结构使开发者能够快速接入自定义算法与业务逻辑，轻松实现平台定制与功能延展。</span></p>
<h2>3. 整体<strong>架构</strong></h2>
<p align="center"><img alt="架构图" width="519" height="621" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/602535/202511/602535-20251114171229776-112489252.png" class="lazyload">&nbsp;</p>
<p>整体流程如下：</p>
<p>(1)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Calibri">Flask</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">接收用户的原始问题，并行调用三个</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，其中</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Calibri">Insight Agent: </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">私有舆情数据库深度分析</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">AI</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">代理，用于私有数据库挖掘。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Calibri">Media Agent: </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">具备强大多模态能力的</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">AI</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">代理，用于多模态内容分析。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Calibri">Query Agent: </span><span style="font-family: 宋体">具备国内外网页搜索能力的</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">AI</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">代理，用于精准信息搜索。</span></p>
<p>(2)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">每个</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">会分别执行以下步骤：</span></p>
<p>1)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">基于用户</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Query</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">生成报告段落</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">(</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">默认为</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">5</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">段</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">)</span></p>
<p>2)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">针对每个段落分别执行初始检索并生成段落报告总结，其中</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Insight Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">主要检索本地数据库，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Media Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">主要通过博查</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">API</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">进行检索，</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Query Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">主要通过</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Tavily API</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">进行检索。</span></p>
<p>3)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">检索之后进行多次迭代反思</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">(</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">默认为</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">3)</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，反思的过程是基于上一步的问题及总结等内容，判定是否存在遗漏偏差等情况，每次迭代均优化上一次迭代的段落总结</span></p>
<p>(3)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">论坛</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">通过监控三个</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的日志，实时收集三者的段落总结内容，且根据最近的</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">5</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">次的段落总结，检测三者是否围绕主题展开，方向是否存偏等问题。且总结后的结果，会同步到初始检索和反思环节，以引导三个</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">围绕主题进行深度研究。</span></p>
<p>(4)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">等</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">4</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">个</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">执行结束后，再运行报告生成</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，生成最终的报告。</span></p>
<h2>4.&nbsp;<strong>核心组件</strong></h2>
<h3><strong><span style="font-family: Calibri">4.1 Insight Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的执行机制</span></strong></h3>
<p align="center"><img alt="Insight Agent" width="377" height="414" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/602535/202511/602535-20251114171344247-1616981261.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p align="justify">(1)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">首先生成报告段落结构</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Plan</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，默认为</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">5</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">个段落，包含</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">title</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">和</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">content</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">。</span></p>
<p align="justify">(2)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">生成的每个段落迭代执行如下流程</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">:</span></p>
<p align="justify">1)&nbsp;初始检索并总结</p>
<p align="justify"><span style="font-family: 宋体">a. 基于</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">title</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">和</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">content</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，针对问题进行改写，以适配不同网站</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">(</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">如</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">B</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">站、小红书、抖音、微博、知乎等</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">)</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的问题风格，并提供诸多查询函数</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">(</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">包括按日期查找热点主题、全局热点主题等方法</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">)</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，输出最适配的查询函数及参数。</span></p>
<p align="justify"><span style="font-family: 宋体">b. 基于改写后的问题，生成核心关键词</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">(</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">默认</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">20</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">个</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">)</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">。</span></p>
<p align="justify">c. 基于关键词以及匹配的查询函数，进行数据库查询，并对数据做去重处理。</p>
<p>d. 针对查询后的结果采用多语言情感分析模型进行分类。</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">e. 基于</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">title</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">content</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">、以及检索结果，生成段落报告总结。</span></p>
<p>2)&nbsp;多次反思迭代及总结</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">整体执行流程与初始检索并总结的流程大体相同，不同之处在于反思检索的输入除了</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">title</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">和</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">content</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">外，还有最新的段落总结</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">(</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">第一次是首次检索后的总结，后续是前次反思迭代后的总结</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">)</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">作为输入。</span></p>
<p>(3)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">多次反思迭代完成后，基于多个段落的内容</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">(title, content, summary</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">等</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">)</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，生成最终的舆情报告。</span></p>
<h3><strong><span style="font-family: Calibri">4.2 Media Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的执行机制</span></strong></h3>
<p align="center"><img alt="Media Agent" width="382" height="341" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/602535/202511/602535-20251114171457161-633714380.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">相比</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Insight Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，流程相对简单一些，主要的不同之处在于前者查询数据库，后者通过博查</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">API</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">进行搜索调用。</span></p>
<h3><strong><span style="font-family: Calibri">4.3 Query Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的执行机制</span></strong></h3>
<p align="center"><img alt="Query Agent" width="382" height="340" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/602535/202511/602535-20251114171549848-457875339.png" class="lazyload">&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">与</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Media Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">流程几乎一致，不同之处只是在于将博查</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">API</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，切换到了 </span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Tavily API</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">。</span></p>
<h2>5.&nbsp;<strong>源码说明</strong></h2>
<p>(1)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">借鉴</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">MediaCrawler</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">项目，可以实时收集</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">B</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">站、小红书、抖音、微博、知乎、贴吧等主流网站，采集代码位于项目中的</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">MediaSpider</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">目录下。</span></p>
<p>(2)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">代码比较简单，且不集成任何框架</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">(</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">包括</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">LangGrahp, LangChain, LammaIndex</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">等</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">)</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">，从头实现了多</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">之间的流程编排及交互。</span></p>
<p>(3)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">代码相对冗余，可能确实是人家</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">20</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">岁小哥的手工作业做出来的。</span></p>
<p>(4)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 宋体">后端以</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Flask</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">提供服务，通过</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">html</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">中的</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Script</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">部分完成前后端的完整交互，且内部基于</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">streamlit</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">嵌入三个</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">的页面。</span></p>
<h2>6.&nbsp;<strong>系统运行效果</strong></h2>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="页面效果" width="792" height="422" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/602535/202511/602535-20251114171625992-641828334.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>7.&nbsp;<strong>总结</strong></h2>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">一句话足矣</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">~</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体">本文主要讲解了微舆的整体架构，并通过研读并调试源码，整理了多个</span><span style="font-family: Calibri">Agent</span><span style="font-family: 宋体">各自的执行流程、以及前后端交互。</span></p>
<p>如项目原理、项目部署、源码等存在疑问，欢迎随时私信或留言交流！</p>
<h2>8.&nbsp;<strong>参考</strong></h2>
